title: Get local incremental reach insights across CTV and linear TV

facts.fact: In a health care campaign run by Monks on The Trade Desk, the CTV portion reached a unique audience of 115,000.
facts.quote: the CTV portion of the campaign reached a unique audience of 115,000

facts.fact: In the Monks case study, 99.5% of the unique CTV audience reached was exposed to the campaign exclusively on CTV, not on cable or broadcast.
facts.quote: Nearly all these viewers (99.5%) were exposed to the campaign exclusively on CTV.

facts.fact: Following the campaign, Comscore reported that co-viewing rates on CTV inventory running on The Trade Desk's platform were 14% higher than rates on a major linear TV network.
facts.quote: Comscore reported that co-viewing rates on CTV inventory running on our platform were 14% higher than rates on a major linear TV network.

facts.fact: Ad-supported CTV has surpassed linear TV in predicted viewership, with 180 million versus 112 million viewers respectively, according to the cited source.
facts.quote: ad-supported CTV has officially surpassed linear TV in predicted viewership, with 180 million versus 112 million viewers, respectively.

facts.fact: The page cites Comscore Campaign Ratings for Q2 2024 as a source, labeled 'Local Comscore Campaign Ratings, Q2 2024.'
The page cites an eMarketer 2024 forecast titled 'TV and Video. U.S. AVOD Viewers and Traditional Pay-TV Viewers' as a source.
facts.quote: 2. Emarketer, 2024 Forecast, “TV and Video. U.S. AVOD Viewers and Traditional Pay-TV Viewers.

facts.fact: The Trade Desk's related case study headline, a different page listed under 'More like this', reports a 7.2% incremental increase for an airline's loyalty program using Conversion Lift.
